minutes.headline: ZBA granted special permits to raze and rebuild homes at 6 Peninsula Drive and 38 Oak Ridge Road.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard two special permit applications to tear down non-conforming lakefront houses and build new dwellings. Both were presented by the same engineering representative, drew no public opposition, and were granted by voice vote with standard post-decision instructions. The meeting then adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit to raze and rebuild the non-conforming lakefront house at 6 Peninsula Drive, by voice vote.
The board then granted a special permit for 38 Oak Ridge Road on the same terms, after hearing the same engineering representative.
Both approvals carried the standard conditions: filing with the town clerk within 14 days, recording at the registry of deeds, and lapse within two years.
No one spoke in public comment on either application, and the meeting adjourned after the second vote.

why_it_matters: Two lakefront lots will see old houses replaced with new ones, which touches setbacks, septic systems and runoff near the water, and may change those homes' assessed values.
watch_next: Whether each permit is recorded at the registry of deeds, and the new dwellings built, before the two-year lapse date set in the conditions.
